cohorts.name: Internal / Test users
cohorts.use: Project test-account filter; excluded from all saved insights

cohorts.name: EncodeX — Power users (10 conversions / 7d)
cohorts.definition: At least 10 conversion_completed events in the last 7 days

cohorts.name: EncodeX — MCP users (toggle on ever)
cohorts.definition: At least one mcp_server_toggled event with enabled = true in the last 3650 days

cohorts.name: EncodeX — Batch users (3 queues / 30d)
cohorts.definition: At least 3 batch_queue_started events in the last 30 days

cohorts.name: EncodeX — Churn risk (active 14–28d, idle 14d)
cohorts.definition: At least one app_launched event 14–28 days ago AND zero app_launched events in the last 14 days
